title: Gyeongbokgung: clarify the Tuesday public-holiday exception
text: The shared place card previously said only “Closed Tuesdays”. It now explains that a Tuesday public holiday shifts closure to the following business day, as published by VisitKorea.
The guide also distinguishes the November–February closing time and last admission from the longer seasonal schedules.

title: BACC: correct the published closing time and admission scope
text: The place card previously stated a 9pm closing time. BACC’s official visitor page publishes 8pm; the card now uses that closing time and records the source check.
The admission description now distinguishes exhibition entry from special events, concerts and plays instead of presenting every programme as free.

title: Dadaocheng: check temporary visitor-centre closures before planning a start
text: The previous starting plan relied on the visitor centre without stating its announced temporary closures. The guide, related Taipei weekend plan and place description now direct readers to the dated official notices.
The centre closure does not establish whether every independent business or outdoor route is accessible. Reopening and any costume reservation require a current official check.

title: Bangkok SkyWalk: published hours and ticket categories
text: The place card previously showed a 7pm closing time. The operator now publishes opening to midnight and last access at 11pm; the guide and card have been corrected.

The operator displays differing price panels. The guide now distinguishes adult, child and senior categories and directs readers to the official booking for the selected date and slot. A lowest “from” price is not presented as the adult fare.

title: Phuket Big Buddha: access remains unconfirmed
text: An old opening-hours claim remained in the place card after the article had explained that current access was unconfirmed. The hours and unsupported free-entry statement have been removed.
This correction does not assert that the site is open or closed. The guide explains what to establish before arranging a visit and offers separate Old Town and museum alternatives.

title: Past event dates and archival photographs
text: The announced main Phuket Vegetarian Festival period, 10–18 October 2026, is now described as past. The Weeknd’s linked 11–13 October Bangkok listing is also identified as an archived example. Neither is presented as an upcoming booking recommendation.

Photograph notes distinguish archival scenes from current events, including a Ping River krathong photograph from 2015 and a Romanian concert crowd from 2022. Image notes identify context; they do not establish a current local programme.

title: Chiang Mai Design Week: use the current announcement and programme
text: The 2026 announcement confirms 5–13 December and the theme Local Thunders, Global Transformation. The organiser’s About page still contains an older 2025 date beneath its updated header.

The guide now relies on the dated announcement and the 2026 programme filters, without treating an office address or broad district name as a confirmed session venue. Workshop availability and registration remain separate checks.

title: Tsukiji: visitor-centre hours are not shop hours
text: The guide now separates Plat Tsukiji visitor-centre opening from individual shops, payment methods and the market calendar. It no longer suggests that every business follows one schedule or payment rule.
The revised plan lets readers choose between a meal, ingredients and kitchenware using the official directory. Toyosu auction viewing remains a separate destination and enquiry.

title: Paris islands: use the cathedral’s own admission instructions
text: The islands guide now explicitly distinguishes Notre-Dame’s free cathedral admission and optional official reservation from paid tours and separate attractions.

A recent update date on the tourism overview did not remove an old post-fire closure passage. The revised section uses the cathedral’s own visitor guidance rather than carrying that closure statement into the route.

title: Visitor tickets and services: clarify what the product includes
text: The Rome guide now explains that the standard 24-hour Colosseum, Forum and Palatine product excludes arena access. The Angkor guide separately explains visiting-day allowances and their validity windows.
Bangkok dental planning now distinguishes BIDH’s published outpatient hours from its 24-hour inpatient provision. These are product and scheduling clarifications, not clinical-quality endorsements.
